run.reason.diskFull: Cancelled because the disk was almost full: AYAR stopped the run safely before a write could fail
run.reason.engineStopped: Interrupted: the engine stopped during the check
run.reason.runInterrupted: Not started: the run was interrupted before it
run.reason.serviceNotReady: Unavailable: the companion service {service} did not become ready
run.reason.timeout: {minutes, plural, one {Timed out after # minute} other {Timed out after # minutes}}
run.reason.idle: {seconds, plural, one {Timed out: no output for # second} other {Timed out: no output for # seconds}}
run.reason.externalSignal: Unavailable: ended from outside AYAR by {signal}
run.reason.runnerUnavailable: Unavailable: the runner {runner} is not available
run.reason.prepareFailed: Unavailable: what the check needs could not be prepared before its launch ({detail})
run.reason.macosPermission: Unavailable: macOS blocked the command; it may need a permission in Privacy settings
run.reason.permissionDenied: Unavailable: no permission to run the command
run.reason.specChangedSinceApproval: Missing: the command changed since it was approved and needs approval again
run.reason.specMissing: Unavailable: the check is no longer in the standards profile
run.reason.specNotVerified: Unavailable: the check’s command could not be verified against the project’s files now, so it did not run
run.reason.notReady: Missing: the check is not ready
run.note.escapeSuspected: A process left the check’s group and may still be running
run.note.leftoversEnded: Processes the check left behind were ended
run.note.sleepGap: The Mac slept during the check; the sleep did not count toward the timeout
run.note.outputTruncated: The output was cut because it exceeded the stored limit
run.note.projectCommandNetwork: This check ran the project’s own command, which AYAR does not cut off from the network: working without the network is promised for AYAR and its tools only
